title: Add leave-one-out backtest for modeled valuation
objective: Measure how Tier C/D modeling performs against known canonical market values before defining confidence gates.

leakage_control: The held-out canonical observation is excluded from training evidence.
Any exact provider observation for the same task_id is excluded from training evidence.
The backtest uses the same shared C/D valuation function as the candidate generator.

interpretation: This step creates measurement only. It does not enable modeled EV or define acceptable model accuracy; confidence gates are the next step.
